title: 3 Things Claude Opus 4.8 Just Changed (The Last One Is Wild)
description:
Claude Opus 4.8 just dropped three major updates and most people don't know what actually changed. 

In this short: sharper judgment for longer unsupervised tasks, fast mode at 2.5x speed for less cost, and dynamic workflows where Claude plans, spawns hundreds of parallel sub-agents, and verifies its own work — all from one prompt.

I'm testing everything this week. Subscribe so you don't miss the results.

#ClaudeCode #Anthropic #AIAgents #Claude4 #YouTubeShorts
